verdict.rationale: Isaac documents the core loop. Real robot demonstrations can be captured via teleoperation and converted for GR00T post-training, and real-world captures can be ingested into Isaac Sim. Pretrained models can be refined with RL Post Training, and a policy's compute graph can be packaged into a portable deployment bundle for real hardware, with Isaac ROS deploying inference on Jetson. However, nothing shows fleet-scale data collection or rolling improved models back out to a fleet. missing for 10: fleet-wide data ingestion from deployed robots, fleet rollout/OTA model update tooling, an automated end-to-end data flywheel, independent or hands-on corroboration.
